content: {"reasoning":"The payer has issued CO-97 (bundled, not separately payable) four times despite prior clean submission, necessity appeal, data correction, and records. This is not an auth or COB issue (auth isn't required, COB is correct), and resubmitting again risks a CO-18 duplicate denial. A bundled service is not separately payable and cannot be billed to the patient, and peer-to-peer/necessity paths are already exhausted with no new documentation to change the bundling determination.","action":"write_off"}
